description: Is COVID-19 rising in US hospitals? Returns weekly new hospital admissions for laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 (adult and paediatric), patients currently in hospital and ICU, the week-on-week change and the season-to-date total, nationally or for one state, from CDC's NHSN Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data. An official reported hospital figure, not a model. It does not count community cases, tests or deaths. (cost: 1 credit)

jurisdiction.description: string, optional, USA or 2-letter state/territory code, default USA

weeks.description: integer, optional, 1-52 most recent weeks, default 4

name: covid_hospital_admissions_weekly
